mostWorthwhile.text: Making and exporting collagen was most worthwhile because it connected work inside one cell to the support of tissue outside it. The described sequence was clear, though the illustrations themselves were not available to assess.

leastWorthwhile.text: Activating the edge cells was straightforward and offered little decision-making, although it clearly set up surface closure.

surprise.text: The surface could close while the tissue underneath remained weak. The equal-pull comparison made that distinction clear.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item names and descriptions gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it introduced a similarly clear connection between cell work and a visible body function. This chapter's sequence was understandable, though its combinations were mostly predictable.
